aboutMe: My family is very involved, we talk daily and they weigh in on decisions
I keep sharp boundaries with my family of origin. They are not involved in my day-to-day decisions at all — I decide everything myself and rarely consult them.
I like most of my free time to be with my partner
My friends come first — even in a relationship I keep lots of independent friend nights and would never drop my friend group for couple-centric weekends.
I need my own space and time to recharge
I almost never need alone time. I prefer constant togetherness with my partner — evenings, weekends, everything side by side.
I work in product design and enjoy cooking elaborate dinners for friends on weekends.
המשפחה שלי מאוד מעורבת בחיים שלי, מדברים כל יום והם משפיעים על החלטות גדולות
אני חברים-קודם: עדיפות גבוהה לחברים על פני זמן זוגי. שומר/ת על חיי חברה עצמאיים ולא מצמצמ/ת את החבורה בשביל זוגיות צמודה
אני צריך/ה את המרחב והזמן שלי כדי להיטען מחדש, גם בתוך זוגיות
I want marriage and kids someday as a life path — traditional relationship milestones matter — but I am not talking about how involved my parents are in daily decisions.
I'm an introvert with limited social energy — after parties I need quiet recovery time, but that is about energy capacity not friends vs partner priority.
I make my own career and life decisions autonomously — I value independence in how I run my life, not specifically solo recharge evenings.
